translations.web: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
translations.bsb: “I heard Your voice in the garden,” he replied, “and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself.”
translations.kjv: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
